categories.description: Product categories (for example beverages, condiments, seafood). Clients may call these product groups or types.

customers.description: Companies that buy from the business (clients, buyers, accounts), with contact person and location.

columns.contact_name: person at the customer to contact

customer_customer_demo.description: Link table between customers and customer demographic types. Not used in sales questions.

customer_demographics.description: Customer demographic type descriptions. Not used in sales questions.

employees.description: Staff who handle orders (sales representatives), with job title, hire date, location and who they report to.

employee_territories.description: Link table assigning employees to sales territories.

order_details.description: Line items of each order: product, unit price charged, quantity and discount. Revenue is unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount).

columns.unit_price: price per unit charged on this order line
columns.discount: fraction between 0 and 1 taken off the line price

orders.description: Customer orders: who ordered, which employee handled it, order, required and shipped dates, shipper, freight cost and shipping address.

columns.shipped_date: date the order left the warehouse; null if not shipped yet

products.description: Products for sale (items, goods): name, supplier, category, price and stock levels.

columns.discontinued: 1 if the product is no longer sold

region.description: Four sales regions. Used only with territories.

shippers.description: Shipping companies (carriers, couriers) that deliver orders.

suppliers.description: Companies that supply the products (vendors), with contact details and location.

territories.description: Sales territories, each inside a region.

us_states.description: Reference list of US states. Not used in sales questions.
